# Konsole and PtyQt notices

Konsole 26.04.3 is built from the official KDE release archive pinned in manifests/source-verification.json. It is upstream KDE software, not AI-generated project code. Original per-file copyrights and licenses remain in the release source.

The backend probe links the same PtyQt ConPTY sources shipped with Konsole. Their notices include Copyright 2019 Vitaly Petrov and Copyright 2023 Waqar Ahmed under the MIT license. Full MIT text is retained in LICENSES/MIT.txt. Other Konsole license texts and COPYING files are retained here.
